children: Canada value-added frozen seafood firm's Q3 revenue rose 16%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 missed analyst estimates
Company to be acquired by Umios Corporation in deal expected to close Q1 2027
Company expects year-over-year Adjusted EBITDA growth in 2026, excluding tariff recoveries
Outlook remains subject to cautious consumer spending, raw material cost pressures and geopolitical uncertainty
TARIFF RECOVERIES - Q3 results benefited from $21.8 mln in International Emergency Economic Powers Act tariff recoveries
PRICING AND VOLUME - Higher sales volumes and increased pricing in response to inflation supported revenue growth
RETAIL AND FOODSERVICE DEMAND - Resilient demand for premium retail brands and stable foodservice channels supported sales
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the food processing peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for High Liner Foods Inc is C$27.00, about 0.6% above its November 10 closing price of C$26.84
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
